_note: Deployed via New-SafeAttachmentPolicy + New-SafeAttachmentRule in Exchange Online PowerShell — not an ARM/Bicep resource. See deploy-email-security.ps1 for the exact commands.
description: Detonation-chamber (dynamic delivery) scanning for email attachments before they reach the mailbox.

settings.custom_note: DynamicDelivery shows the email body immediately with attachments held back until detonation completes — chosen over 'Block' (which delays the whole message) since it doesn't degrade legitimate mail flow while still fully gating attachments. ActionOnError=true means a scan failure fails safe (blocks) rather than fails open (delivers unscanned).
